learnings: Models must distinguish between metadata inconsistencies (url field vs source URL) and actual security risks. The 'url' field is informational metadata, not a security boundary.
When an artifact is checksum-verified with a real hash (not SKIP), URL mismatches do not constitute supply-chain attacks because makepkg rejects substituted bytes.
Prompt guidance should clarify that 'fetching from a host the package has no stated relationship with' refers to the source URL itself, not the 'url' metadata field.
